import random
import cocotb
from cocotb.clock import Clock
from cocotb.triggers import RisingEdge, FallingEdge, Timer
from multigent.verifier_tool.coverage.runtime import contract_coverage, sample_operation
from reference.uadd8_ref import uadd8_to_u9

COVERAGE_OBLIGATIONS = {
    "channel.in_chan.handshake_states",
    "channel.in_chan.stall_stability",
    "channel.out_chan.handshake_states",
    "channel.out_chan.stall_stability",
    "signal.rst_n.reset_behavior",
    "operation.uadd_pair.opcode",
    "operation.uadd_pair.vector_length",
    "operation.uadd_pair.operand_classes",
    "operation.uadd_pair.numeric_behavior",
    "operation.uadd_pair.predication",
    "operation.uadd_pair.fixed_opcode_add_only",
    "operation.uadd_pair.scalar_single_element_per_transaction",
    "operation.uadd_pair.no_predication_supported",
}

STIMULUS_COVERAGE_INTENTS = [
    {"label": "boundary_and_latency", "targets": ["channel.in_chan.handshake_states", "channel.out_chan.handshake_states", "operation.uadd_pair.numeric_behavior", "operation.uadd_pair.vector_length", "operation.uadd_pair.scalar_single_element_per_transaction"]},
    {"label": "input_stall_1", "targets": ["channel.in_chan.stall_stability", "operation.uadd_pair.opcode", "operation.uadd_pair.fixed_opcode_add_only"]},

    {"label": "input_stall_long", "targets": ["channel.in_chan.stall_stability"]},

    {"label": "output_stall_short", "targets": ["channel.out_chan.stall_stability"]},
    {"label": "output_stall_long", "targets": ["channel.out_chan.stall_stability"]},
    {"label": "reset_idle", "targets": ["signal.rst_n.reset_behavior"]},
    {"label": "reset_during_pending", "targets": ["signal.rst_n.reset_behavior"]},
    {"label": "randomized_stream", "targets": ["operation.uadd_pair.operand_classes", "operation.uadd_pair.numeric_behavior"]},
]

    {"operation": "uadd_pair", "point": "operation.uadd_pair.opcode", "template": "discrete_mode", "event": "clock", "fields": {"value": {"signal": "in_valid", "lsb": 0, "width": 1}}, "legal_values": [1]},
